body:
I was at one of those piss up parties where everyone was supposed to get trashed (which they did) but because of some previous BAD experiences with booze I decided I would rather try dope for the first time.
The party started at around noon and by 4 o'clock all the drinkers were slowly calming down. My friend A arrived with some dope (supposedly strong shit) and anyway at about 7 oclock other friends and I rolled a joint and started smoking it. Being my first time, I never really knew what would happen but after about 3 hits my heart started beating so fast and I couldn't catch my breath in other words I thought I was going to die!
After about 10 minutes nothing had really happened and I thought it was not gonna work. About 5 mins later I found myself looking back and forth at 2 different objects and it seemed as every time I changed my view it was like everything was slide by slide like photos. Every time I blinked the darkness felt longer than usual and I couldn't focus on what I was doing. People were telling me things and I was looking at them but wasn't really listening, instead I was thinking about lots of other things and my experiences effects. There was a bubble in my throat and I just couldn't catch my breath but it was not bothering me. There was some music playing and even though my ears felt blocked it was loud and every beat felt like a wave that vibrated through my body into my chest. Every time someone touched me the same thing happened. About 15 mins later I couldn't focus on what I was doing. I did not know it, but I was walking automatically while my mind was somewhere else. I eventually walked into a glass door but it felt so good when my body hit it and I couldn't stop laughing about what just happened. The rest of the night was pretty cool and by 12 oclock I was feeling damn tired so I decided to sleep at another friends house as there was no chance of getting any rest at the party.
I woke up the next morning feeling fresh but my eyes were a bit sore. I think its a better option than drinking.
